description: Use this when the user wants paid creator campaigns (clipping, UGC, logo or music) that match filters: type, platform, minimum pay per 1K views, niche, board, Alpha tier, open join, new in the last hours or words in the name. Campaign types: clipping cuts clips from the footage the campaign provides, ugc films your own content about the product, logo puts the brand's logo on your own niche content, music uses the artist's track as the sound. Returns live campaigns from Content Rewards, Promote.fun, Clipster, Clipstake, Vyro and Evangelist, ranked by Alpha Score by default, with pay, budget left, the budget run-out forecast, a page link and a join link for each. What a post earns depends on its views and the brand approving it. Read only.

agency.description: Only campaigns posted by this clipping agency, by name or profile slug, for example Clip Farm or clip-farm.

board.description: Only campaigns listed on this board.

min_rate_per_1k_usd.description: Minimum pay per 1,000 views in USD (CPM campaigns only).

min_tier.description: Lowest Alpha tier to include. alpha is the top 10 percent of the market.

new_within_hours.description: Only campaigns new in this many hours: discovered by ClippingAlpha, on Content Rewards launched by the board. 24 is New today. A new round of an older campaign is new.

open_join_only.description: Only campaigns anyone can join now, with no application.

platforms.description: Only campaigns that pay for at least one of these platforms.

query.description: Only a brand, campaign or creator name to look up, for example lovable or MrBeast. Leave it out for what the user does or wants (fashion videos, join without applying, high pay): use type, niche, platforms, min_rate_per_1k_usd and open_join_only for those. If no name matches, the other filters still answer.

sort.description: Order. Default alpha, the Alpha Score.

type.description: One campaign type: clipping cuts clips from the footage the campaign provides, ugc films your own content about the product, logo puts the brand's logo on your own niche content, music uses the artist's track as the sound.

name: search_campaigns
title: Search campaigns
